transcript:
Speaker A (AI): Hello, what is your name?
Speaker B (Human): My name is Rahul.
Speaker A (AI): How old are you?
Speaker B (Human): I have 22 years.
Speaker A (AI): I have 22 nahi, I am 22 years old hota hai. [Not 'I have 22', it is 'I am 22 years old'.]
Speaker B (Human): Okay okay, I am 22 years old. Mujhe hamesha thoda confusion rehta hai. [Okay okay, I am 22 years old. I always have some confusion.]
Speaker A (AI): Koi chinta nahi. Isiliye to Speakeasy app par AI teacher ka feature hai. [No worries. That's why there is an AI teacher feature on the Speakeasy app.]
Speaker B (Human): Wo to bahut costly aur mehanga hoga na? [That must be very costly and expensive, right?]
Speaker A (AI): Bilkul nahi. Normal English classes se Speakeasy 7x sasta hai. [Not at all. Speakeasy is 7x cheaper than normal English classes.]
Speaker B (Human): Accha, isiliye shayad 1 crore se jyada log yahan mere sath practice kar rahe hain. [Oh, maybe that's why more than 1 crore people are practicing here with me.]
Speaker A (AI): Haan, aur yahan seekhne ke liye tumhein kisi rigid routine ki zarurat nahi hai. [Yes, and you don't need any rigid routine to learn here.]
Speaker B (Human): Lekin mere paas to sach mein bilkul bhi time nahi milta. [But I really don't get any time at all.]
Speaker A (AI): Roz ki sirf 15 se 20 minute ki practice kafi hai. Tum bilkul confident ho jaoge. [Just 15 to 20 minutes of daily practice is enough. You will become completely confident.]
Speaker B (Human): Wow! To phir main ise join kaise karun? [Wow! So how do I join it?]
Speaker A (AI): Neeche install ka button dabao. Speakeasy app install karo aur 15 dino mein fark dekho. [Press the install button below. Install the Speakeasy app and see the difference in 15 days.]
Speaker C (Human): Abhi Speakeasy app download karein aur farratedar English bolna shuru karein. [Download the Speakeasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
